reference: AH-64D Longbow: TM 1-1520-251-10 cockpit figures; Chuck's DCS AH-64D guide (chucksguides.com/aircraft/dcs/ah-64d). Pilot: EUFD, two MPDs, standby airspeed/attitude/altimeter, centre cyclic, collective and two power levers on the left; CPG: two MPDs around the TEDAC/ORT, side-arm cyclic on the right console, collective and power levers on the left; Panel layout: gamepressure.com DCS AH-64D 'Pilot/CPG Cockpits and Controls' (pilot: fire detection/extinguishing unit, EUFD, two MPDs, armament panel, standby attitude/airspeed/altimeter, keyboard unit on the left of the panel; CPG: fire unit, armament panel, left MPD, TEDAC, EUFD, right MPD, keyboard on the left console, no standby instruments), DCS AH-64D Quick Start Manual fig. 19 'Pilot's Cockpit, Forward', dcs.man-sim.org AH-64D overview (standby instruments only in the pilot station). MPDs and TEDAC drawn about 2x real (6 x 6 in screens: pilot MPDs 0.345, CPG TEDAC 0.33 and MPDs 0.285, the most that fits above the consoles) so they dominate the panel; the CPG station is widened to the canopy to hold three; no photo could be downloaded in this environment, so positions within those lists are from memory of the cockpit.
